name: io.github.Servosity/kaseya-vsa-mcp
title: Kaseya VSA 10 MCP
description: Kaseya VSA 10 API, plus a local fleet mirror for patch, health and software questions across clients

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSA_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Your VSA 10 instance host name, for example yourcompany.vsax.net (no https://).

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSA_TOKEN_ID
environmentVariables.description: VSA 10 API token ID (Administration > Configuration > API Access).

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSA_TOKEN_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: VSA 10 API token secret, shown once when the token is created.

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSA_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSA_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSA_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The full VSA 10 API base URL, https://<server>/api/v3, instead of KASEYA_VSA_SERVER. Leave blank to build it from KASEYA_VSA_SERVER.

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSA_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on VSA 10 requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.
